runtimeTraceSummary.note: Measured ANE hardware intervals during the recording; labels may be model-specific or generic. Counts can include first prediction and warmups; each call may contain multiple ANE partitions. This is runtime ANE participation, not a percentage of all model operations or CPU/GPU wall time. Device plans and cost weights are separate estimates. Attached recordings can lose program labels: generic hardware intervals are time-correlated with PID-scoped batch signposts and are NOT independently process-attributed. Interval wall time is not an exact CPU/ANE operation or utilization percentage. Raw trace may include system context and remains local.

limitations: Seven visually inspected known queries are a smoke test, not held-out accuracy or temporal action validation.
Sparse samples and center crop can miss content. Similarity is not probability; absent queries still rank candidates.
Separate CLI invocations include compilation/verification startup. Prediction timings exclude preprocessing, tokenizer, normalization and loading.
Generic attached ANE intervals are temporally correlated with PID-scoped batch signposts, not independently process-attributed or exact operation/utilization percentages.
Background applications were not controlled; GPU/all results are specific to these runs.
Minimum macOS 15 and simultaneous playback responsiveness were not tested.
privacy: Source aliases replace private paths. No media, weights, embeddings, raw traces, host IDs or unrelated process details are published.

processMemoryRun.measurement: /usr/bin/time -l; process metrics, not aggregate device/XPC peak or strict budget
